figures.title: A pass is not a coverage
figures.alt: A pass counts a roller crossing over one point. Coverage concerns the full mat width. A point may receive two passes while the full width has received only one complete coverage. Three coloured bands are conceptual, not an operating pattern.
figures.credit: Adapted from Asphalt Institute. (2007). The asphalt handbook (7th ed., MS-4). Figure 9.1, p. 416 / PDF 450. Replaced the original five-pass pattern with separate point and full-width concepts, plus a new record-reading example. No operating pattern is prescribed.  Copyright 2007 by Asphalt Institute. ACCESS redraw (2026).
